items.Sentence: The WWTF will include an influent pump station and head works, flow equalization, fine screening, advanced biological treatment, an anoxic zone to provide for nitrogen reduction, UV disinfection, solids handling, and recycled water storage.

For the first two phases, Phase A and Phase B, the WWTF will consist of membrane bioreactor (MBR) package plants with average maximum dry weather design flows of 0.25 million gallons per day (mgd) and 0.5 mgd, respectively.
